text:
Marta Ruiz (Employee):hi team — my May paystub shows both CA and OR state withholding. i moved from OR to CA mid-pay-period (May 12). i expected CA only for days after move.
Anya (People Ops):thanks for flagging. did you update your address in Workday and submit CA withholding form?
Marta Ruiz (Employee):i updated address May 12 evening but i hadn't uploaded the CA state form yet.
Kelvin (Payroll):pulling payrun 2026-05-31 for MARTA (ID 11022). system split withholding by calendar-day rules. because you had OR on file at period start, OR withheld for the whole period. we can reclassify days after 05/12 to CA.
Jared (Manager):we discussed Marta's relocation in sync but didn't realize the tax form timing would matter. apologies.
Anya (People Ops):Marta, can you upload the CA DE-4 or state withholding cert? payroll-bot can remind.
payroll-bot: reminder sent to Marta. upload link: https://adp.example.company/forms/11022
Marta Ruiz (Employee):uploaded DE-4 and confirmed residency as CA effective 2026-05-12. receipt DE4-mruiz-2026-05-13.pdf
Kelvin (Payroll):thanks. plan: run off-cycle to pro-rate withholding: change OR withholding to cover 05/01-05/11, CA withholding for 05/12-05/31. will adjust year-to-date and state tax codes for W-2. estimate delta: additional CA withheld ~$18, OR refund ~$12 -> net delta small.
Anya (People Ops):estimate turnaround? Marta is worried about net impact.
Kelvin (Payroll):once docs in ADP, off-cycle within 48 hours. will annotate employee record: "mid-month state change; forms received 2026-05-13; off-cycle queued."
Marta Ruiz (Employee):thanks — appreciate the quick help.
Kelvin (Payroll):off-cycle processed 2026-05-15 08:22 UTC. paystub updated; YTD state allocations corrected. recorded note: "Mid-month residency change pro-rated for MARTA ID11022."
Anya (People Ops):closing loop, updating relocation checklist to remind new residents to submit state form before first payrun. :white_check_mark:
